_comment: External override of the vendored canonical project mapping (read FIRST by load_config -> _resolve_project_mappings, per the documented resolution order). Adds the CAMPPS initiative board (Project #4) so `board add` routes campps-* repos there and `discover-project` resolves them. Project node IDs are best-effort; field/option IDs are NEVER cached here (fetched live).
_provenance: campps board (Project #4, id PVT_kwDODdfJoc4BanD0) registered 2026-06-16 as the active execution board for the CAMPPS Phase-1a build (see docs/process/board-topology.md). campps-context-library moved from the former Olympus board to campps (it is the campps board's home repo). Asgard/Operations ids carried from the vendored canonical (verified 2026-05-29). Project #3 was renamed Jeff Intent -> Operations on 2026-06-27, mirroring the canonical rename in infiquetra-sdlc; the project number, node id, and shared intent_flow workflow are unchanged. Mount Olympus Project #1 was retired from active routing on 2026-06-17.

campps._workflow_note: Lightweight initiative flow: Idea -> Committed -> In Progress -> Done (+ Parked). `board add`, `discover-project`, board view, and board move route through the vendored CAMPPS schema.
